 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE RAJESH H.SHUKLA  
 Date : 06/10/2015

ORAL ORDER 1. Present Criminal Misc. Application has been filed by the applicantState under  Section 378 (1)(3) of the Code Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeking leave to appeal  challenging the impugned judgment and order of acquittal passed in Criminal  C a s e N o . 2 8 3 o f 1 9 9 2 b y t h e A d d i t i o n a l C h i e f J u d i c i a l M a g i s t r a t e , 
Rajkot dated 07.04.2015, on the grounds stated in the application. 
2. Heard learned APP Shri H.L. Jani for applicantState.
Though  served no one has remained present for the respondent original accused.
3. In view of the submissions and having perused the papers and considering the reasons
r e c o r d e d f o r t h e t h e f i n d i n g s a n d  conclusion arrived at, the matter requires consideration.
Learned APP has referred to the  submission with regard to non compliance of provision of Section 13 (2) of the  Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, which requires closer scrutiny.
